description: The optional last argument of a `$rdist_*` function says whether the draw is shared by every instance ("global", the default) or made separately for each one ("instance"), LRM 9.13.2 Table 9-2. Any other text is not a type this function knows, and guessing one would change which values the instances draw.
actions: Write "global" or "instance", or leave the argument out for "global".
